said.speaker: profile
said.text:
Adaptability. Of what you can train, it would add most to your recent work: 10 of your last 12 pieces call on it. Composure and listening and responsiveness would be about as useful.
Adjustments at the Developing tier, with Focus on Steady. It’s in the Practice column under Attributes And Craft on your Player Profile: open it and press Practice An Hour. An hour costs 3 energy.
Estimate: 20 hours, an hour a day, would take it from 65 to about 68, worth about 0.3 points a piece on your recent work.
Not now: Yale Rep’s October Production: You’re On As An Understudy In The Company starts at 2:00 PM: there isn’t the time before it.
said.details:
How The Estimate Is Worked Out: Each estimate is your recent work judged again as you are now, with the hours of practice added: what that would be worth a piece, in points of the whole, the latest piece counting most. For adaptability, 10 of your last 12 pieces call on it; An Enemy Of The People would gain most, about +0.5. Set Focus to Steady to start. Spaced pays more once your last session is a day to a week old. It’s an estimate: it reads only the work on your record, and the work you do next may call on different things.
What It Assumes Of Your Work: What the forecast assumes of your last 12 pieces: 10 were fully prepared, and 2 were underprepared and are counted as they were. None of them depends on knowing a genre.
Preparation Or Training: Both preparation and training are worth your time now, preparation more: coming to your recent work fully prepared would have added about 1.42 a piece as you are now (1.42 from each piece’s own preparation, 0.00 from knowing its genre in full), and 20 hours of adaptability would add about 0.28.
How Long It’s Been First: It took over from composure on October 12, 2027. Composure had led since October 11, 2027, and by then it had gone from 54.3 to 54.9 and its forecast from 0.22 to 0.27 a piece. It has led the advice on what to train since October 12, 2027, 5 days ago. Since then it’s gone from 63.7 to 64.9, and its forecast from 0.30 to 0.28 a piece. Of the 8 pieces you’ve done since, it held back 6, most recently Three Sisters, on October 16, 2027. You’ve practiced Adjustments for 6 hours since. What moved its forecast since it took the lead: the work it’s forecast on, +0.0776; your other abilities and techniques, −0.0204; its own level, −0.0733. Since October 17, 2027 you’ve put in 1 hour of Adjustments: it went from 64.7 to 64.9, and its forecast from 0.281 to 0.279. What moved its forecast since October 17, 2027: its own level, −0.0023.
From Your Record: What held your last piece back most was composure, but it isn’t what pays most to train now: 20 hours of it are forecast at about 0.26 a piece, against 0.28 for adaptability. Adaptability is called on by more of your recent work, or has more room to grow.
Other Things Worth Your Time: Composure, Graded Exposure at the Developing tier: an estimated 0.3 points a piece for 20 hours, from 56 to about 60. About as useful as the first. Listening And Responsiveness, The Repetition Exercise at the Developing tier: an estimated 0.2 points a piece for 20 hours, from 72 to about 74. About as useful as the first. Memory, A Recall Drill at the Developing tier: an estimated 0.2 points a piece for 20 hours, from 62 to about 65. Focus, Circles Of Attention at the Developing tier: an estimated 0.2 points a piece for 20 hours, from 73 to about 76.
